copy.tagline: 引导新用户快速熟悉产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为新用户提供友好的产品导览
copy.tagline_en: Guide new users through your product quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to offer a friendly product tour to first-time users

howto.what: 安装后，当用户第一次使用omo时，Claude会担任引导员，按顺序带用户完成六个环节：功能参观、迁移帮助、历史会话分析、价值估算、记忆记录和init-deep建议。其中三个环节由用户自主选择是否参加。
howto.when: 用户首次启动omo时自动触发一次；之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 重新唤起，也可用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关掉自动启动。

say.text: 带我看一遍 omo 的主要功能
say.note: 进入功能参观环节，按组介绍各项能力

say.text: 帮我迁移 Claude Code 的配置和设置
say.note: 进入迁移帮助，先读取现有配置再给迁移计划

say.text: 分析我以前的编程会话帮我找规律
say.note: 进入会话考古，会扫描本机各平台历史会话

howto.what_en: On first use of omo, Claude acts as a guide for a six-lane onboarding tour: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, and an init-deep proposal. Three lanes are opt-in.
howto.when_en: It auto-starts once on the user's first omo session. It can be re-triggered anytime with the `senpi --onboard` flag, and auto-start can be disabled with `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: Give me a tour of omo's main features.
say_en.note: Enters the feature-tour lane, covering highlights in groups.

say_en.text: Help me migrate my Claude Code config and settings.
say_en.note: Enters migration help; it reads existing configs, then shows a plan.

say_en.text: Analyse my past coding sessions to find patterns.
say_en.note: Enters session archaeology; scans local session histories.
